$comment: Fixture #1: the counter island. `expected` carries the numbers so that a backend fix flips a value here and nothing else. See README.md.
name: counter

expected.$keys: The hydration keys in allocation order, relative to the render id. The counter has no components, so its one template root takes root slot 0 and there is nothing to nest. Declared anyway: it is what makes the scheme check non-vacuous here, and it is the value the `nested` fixture's list is the interesting version of.
expected.$components: Component boundaries in the source. Zero, so every slot the keys imply must be spent by an element that carries it.
expected.$hydrateMutations: How many MutationRecords the hydrate bracket produces. 0 is the target and the value hydration is supposed to have: solid's insertExpression returns early for a string or number hole while hydrating, so a correctly claimed text hole is a no-op.
expected.$htmlAfterHydrate: null means the mount must serialize identically before and after hydration. A string means it must equal that string exactly -- use that form only to record a known, reviewed defect.
expected.$clickMutations: MutationRecords from one click on +1. 1 is the target and the current value: upstream claims only the value between the markers, so an update writes .data on the server's text node. (The getNextMarker defect used to cost 3; fixed in wave 5.)
expected.$clickHtml: The count element after one click, with both marker comments preserved.
